caption: The drawing features two distinct sections. The upper section displays a semicircular panel with a central human figure dressed in red and pink garments with brown details, featuring a light brown face and hands, a short beard, a white halo with black dots, and large blue wings. The figure is positioned with one bent arm and the other raised, both hands open, and is surrounded by a multicolored border in blue, orange, red, and black. On each side of the central figure, there are two stylized orange, red, and blue plant-like forms stemming from beige pots decorated with black dots. The bottom of the semicircle has a wavy scalloped pattern in red, blue, and green with dot embellishments. The lower section of the drawing shows a separately depicted border fragment with a repeating scalloped motif in red, pink, and black, set against a pale blue background, bordered by brown on the edges. The background of the entire drawing is a neutral, off-white color.
title: Plate 15: The Creation (Lunette): From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
